avis.titre: Subtle and Slow ResultsSubtle and Slow Results
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for a little while now and have just about finished the bottle. I like that it's a very gentle, non-irritating formula. It doesn't have a scent and it absorbs into my skin really quickly without leaving a sticky feel. I've been applying it consistently to see how it handles discoloration, especially on my elbows. The serum does brighten and lighten dark spots, but I've noticed it happens very slowly. It isn't nearly as dramatic as the results shown in the advertisements. You really have to stay on top of using it every day to see any progress. While I think it works fine for general brightening, I was hoping for something with a bit more strength for tougher areas like my dark elbows. Based on the campaign ads and social media hype, I expected much stronger results in brightening and softening. It's a nice product to use because of how well it sinks in, but it just didn't give me the level of results I was looking for. Since I want something more powerful for lightening, I probably won't repurchase this one anytime soon. I'm going to keep trying different products until I find something that works a bit faster on those stubborn spots.

avis.titre: A Gentle, Supportive Brightening Serum That Improves Skin Without Overworking It
avis.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry, increasingly sensitive skin, I approach brightening and vitamin products very carefully. Many of them promise glow and radiance but end up being too aggressive, leaving my skin dry, irritated, or compromised. At this stage, I’m far more interested in products that support skin quality over time rather than push for dramatic, fast results. This is not a miracle product — and that’s actually one of its strengths. I see this more as a supportive, gentle brightening serum that helps maintain healthy-looking skin without overworking it. It’s the kind of product that fits beautifully into a long-term routine, especially if you’re already using stronger actives or simply want something that improves tone and radiance without irritation. The texture is excellent. It has a lightweight, slightly cushioned feel that spreads easily and absorbs well. It doesn’t feel greasy, sticky, or heavy, and it layers beautifully with the rest of my routine without any fragrance. I’ve had no issues using it under moisturizer or sunscreen, and it sits well on the skin without pilling. What I appreciate most is how it improves overall skin quality. This is not a dramatic overnight product, and I think that’s important to say clearly. Instead, it’s more about steady support — helping the skin look brighter, smoother, and more even over time. My skin looks healthier and more refined when I use this consistently, and that’s exactly what I want from a vitamin serum at this

avis.titre: Don’t use if you’re on any retinol or treitnoin, even if the first week is amazing
avis.texte: At the beginning, it was wonderful. My skin was glowing, I got many compliments, and my skin genuinely looked brighter. I had no initial purging, and when I patch tested it, it was fine. I gave it another week, and that’s when I noticed a significant difference in my skin. I began purging hormonal acne in places that I hadn’t broken out in months, and it left dark spots that it promised to get rid of. I figured it was purging and continued, however, my skin is now full of acne that I’m not sure how to fix. I do believe that the root of the issue was that I was using treitnoin while using this product. I will give anything back to just being on treitnoin and waiting for the marks to go away themselves, but now I am left with many many marks that can’t be fixed just yet. In addition, I’m not able to use treitnoin the same way that I was once. I blame my lack of research, but I also believe that this product failed to live up to its promise.

Not for My Sensitive Skin I purchased this serum because it’s very popular on social media and has received a lot of hype. Unfortunately, it did not work for me. I have sensitive skin, but I regularly use products with active ingredients and rarely experience irritation. After applying this serum, I developed noticeable redness, burning, and irritation on my cheeks. The reaction was stronger than anything I typically experience with skincare products. I stopped using it immediately, and my skin improved after discontinuing it. It may work well for others, but in my case it was not compatible with my skin. Just a reminder that not everything that goes viral on social media is automatically good for everyone. Skincare is very personal. If you have sensitive or redness-prone skin, I recommend doing a patch test first. I’m giving it two stars only because the return process was easy.
